newsitem.title: SWEDEN: EU members to form central organisation of CSDs.
newsitem.headline: EU members to form central organisation of CSDs.

text.p: European Union members will link their central securities depositories (CSDs) to form the European Central Securities Depositories Association (ECSDA), the Swedish CSD, Vardepapperscentralen (VPC) said on Monday.
The 13 European CSDs met in Stockholm on Monday.
"The aim of the association is to encourage cooperation between its members so as to develop and enhance relationships between them," VPC said in a statement.
"The first issue to be addressed by the ECSDA will be the efficient transfer of securities for use as collateral within the future payments system of the European central banks (TARGET)."
The association will be managed by a steering committee consisting of one representive from each CSD member.
Elias Kazarian, executive principal adviser at VPC, told Reuters on Friday that the CSD could decide to link electronically on Monday.
But the VPC statement did not say whether or not electronic linking would take place and no one was available for comment.
While EU has 15 members, there are only 13 CSDs as Ireland operates via Britain and Luxembourg via Belgium.
All the CSDs register trading in equity and debt instruments, while some also handle clearing.
